title: Disney Songs & Music
description: Lyrics, composers, and the films behind the biggest songs.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Let It Go'?
questions.explanation: Sung by Idina Menzel as Elsa in Frozen (2013), it won the Oscar for Best Original Song that year.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'A Whole New World'?
questions.explanation: The magic carpet duet from Aladdin (1992) won both the Oscar and Grammy for Song of the Year.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Hakuna Matata'?
questions.explanation: Sung by Timon and Pumbaa to a runaway Simba in The Lion King (1994), the Swahili phrase means 'no worries.'

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Under the Sea'?
questions.explanation: Performed by Sebastian the crab in The Little Mermaid (1989), it won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Part of Your World'?
questions.explanation: Ariel's wistful 'I want' song in The Little Mermaid (1989), it was nearly cut after a test screening before being saved.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Be Our Guest'?
questions.explanation: Lumière leads the enchanted servants in the showstopping dinner number in Beauty and the Beast (1991).

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'You've Got a Friend in Me'?
questions.explanation: Written and performed by Randy Newman, it opens Pixar's Toy Story (1995) and became the franchise's signature theme.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'How Far I'll Go'?
questions.explanation: Written by Lin-Manuel Miranda for Moana (2016), it's the heroine's 'I want' song about being called to the sea.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'We Don't Talk About Bruno'?
questions.explanation: From Encanto (2021), it became the first Disney song to top the Billboard Hot 100 in nearly thirty years.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Circle of Life'?
questions.explanation: Written by Elton John and Tim Rice, it opens The Lion King (1994) with the sunrise over the Pride Lands.

questions.prompt: Who composed the score for The Lion King (1994)?
questions.explanation: Zimmer won his first Oscar for the score; the songs themselves were written by Elton John and Tim Rice.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the songs 'Let It Go' and 'Into the Unknown' for Frozen?
questions.explanation: The husband-and-wife songwriting team are among the few EGOT winners and also wrote the songs for Coco and Frozen II.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the songs for Encanto and Moana?
questions.explanation: The Hamilton creator also wrote songs for Mary Poppins Returns and provided the voice of Lin-Manuel-style verses across Disney.

questions.prompt: Who sang 'You've Got a Friend in Me' for Toy Story?
questions.explanation: Newman also composed the scores for Toy Story 1-4, A Bug's Life, Monsters Inc., and Cars.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'I'll Make a Man Out of You'?
questions.explanation: Captain Li Shang drills the army recruits in the training montage in Mulan (1998); the song was performed by Donny Osmond.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Reflection'?
questions.explanation: Mulan's 'I want' ballad in the 1998 film, the pop version performed by Christina Aguilera launched her music career.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Colors of the Wind'?
questions.explanation: From Pocahontas (1995), it won the Oscar for Best Original Song and was performed by Judy Kuhn in the film.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'When You Wish Upon a Star'?
questions.explanation: Sung by Jiminy Cricket in Pinocchio (1940), it became the unofficial Disney company anthem and plays over the Walt Disney logo.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Bare Necessities'?
questions.explanation: Baloo the bear teaches Mowgli his easygoing philosophy in The Jungle Book (1967); it was the film's only Oscar-nominated song.

questions.prompt: Which film features the song 'Remember Me'?
questions.explanation: Written by the Lopezes for Coco (2017), the song won the Oscar for Best Original Song and ties together the film's family theme.

questions.prompt: Who composed the score for Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl?
questions.explanation: Badelt is officially credited but the score was developed by a team at Hans Zimmer's Media Ventures studio under tight deadline.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the lyrics for The Little Mermaid (1989) songs?
questions.explanation: Ashman partnered with composer Alan Menken on Mermaid, Beauty and the Beast, and Aladdin before his death from AIDS in 1991.

questions.prompt: Who composed the music for The Little Mermaid, Beauty and the Beast, and Aladdin?
questions.explanation: Menken has won eight Oscars — more than any other living person — for his work on the Disney Renaissance films.

questions.prompt: Which Disney park attraction features the song 'It's a Small World'?
questions.explanation: The Sherman Brothers wrote the song for the 1964 World's Fair ride, which then moved to Disneyland in 1966.

questions.prompt: Which film features the villain song 'Poor Unfortunate Souls'?
questions.explanation: Ursula sings it while convincing Ariel to sign away her voice in The Little Mermaid (1989).
